title: Level 3 (Advanced) - C-27
notes:
West leads the ♥5 against 4♥. The trump lead seems like a good start for the defense. South has a certain club loser. South may also have to lose 3 diamond tricks.

It seems natural for South to win the lead in the dummy and play a diamond towards the ♦K. If West can win the ♦A, the contract will almost certainly fail. West will return a second trump and the defense will arrange for the player with the third trump to win the next diamond trick.

South can improve this plan by winning the first heart in hand and immediately ducking a diamond. The trump continuation should be won in dummy for a second diamond play. If the ♦K loses to the ♦A with West, he may have no trumps to return. South will be able to ruff his diamond loser in the dummy.

South will still succeed by playing this way if East has the ♦A (although he will be sacrificing an overtrick). South can afford to lose 2 diamond tricks. By playing as suggested, South maximizes his chances of not losing 3 tricks in diamonds.
